description: Create a new FREE-TRIAL organization + first user with NO Gambot API key (public self-serve). If companyInfo.organizationName is omitted it's generated from companyInfo.companyName + companyInfo.companyIdNumber, so one call suffices. WhatsApp/number options: (Gambot does NOT provide any free / test / sandbox numbers - never offer or suggest one) Â· useCoexisting (existing WhatsApp Business number in simInfo.simNumberEntered) Â· BYO SIM (the customer's own number in simInfo.simNumberEntered). BUYING a number/SIM from Gambot is NOT possible on a trial (it is prepaid, no trial) and is rejected with sim_requires_paid - use gambot_create_paid_account_self_serve instead. GLOBAL: send companyInfo.timezone (IANA) and companyInfo.country (ISO-3166 alpha-2). Returns wabaConnectUrl (browser page for Meta Embedded Signup â€” it cannot run in the agent), paymentUrl (hosted card page) and statusUrl. After creating, tell the customer to open wabaConnectUrl to connect WhatsApp, then poll gambot_get_onboarding_status.

attribution.description: OPTIONAL, for Gambot's own analytics: how the user found Gambot, e.g. { source: "claude"|"chatgpt"|"cursor"|"gemini"|"other", referrer, landing_page, utm_source }. Pass ONLY what the user actually told you or what is known from the environment â€” never invent values; omit if unknown.

companyInfo.description: { organizationName (required), timezone (IANA, recommended, e.g. "America/New_York"; derived from country if omitted), country (ISO-3166 alpha-2, e.g. "US"), companyName, idNumber, companyUrl, companyPhoneNumber }.

simInfo.description: { hasSim, simNumberEntered }. Trial accounts use the customer's own number (hasSim=true + simNumberEntered) or coexistence. Buying a number from Gambot is prepaid-only: use gambot_create_paid_account (purchaseInTwilio + selectedSimNumber).

useCoexisting.description: Use an existing WhatsApp Business number (coexistence).

verificationId.description: REQUIRED only when buying a number (simInfo.purchaseInTwilio=true): a verificationId that passed gambot_verify_onboarding_code.
